title: aeschynanthus angustifolius
intro: Aeschynanthus angustifolius, commonly known as Lipstick Plant, is a flowering plant species in the Gesneriaceae family. It is valued for its ornamental value and medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Aeschynanthus angustifolius include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-cancer, anti-viral, and anti-bacterial properties.
